svg.text: SOLDER FUME EXTRACTOR — PERFBOARD LAYOUT · REV D
component side, looking down on the parts · 0.1 in grid · 32 × 20 holes ≈ 81 × 51 mm · bodies drawn to scale
Checked by pcb.py: every net connected, no shorts, one leg per hole, no part under another, no wire across a foreign joint.
pad layout varies — read the silkscreen
Lines show WHICH holes join, not the
exact path. Bend wires around joints.
solder straight onto the socket pins
Shortest legs possible — that is the point.
Meter on DIODE test, red on +12 V row,
black on 0 V row: the reading must CLIMB
to OL as C1A/C1B charge. A steady 0.5-
0.7 V means D1 is in BACKWARDS.
Both C1 stripes (-) face the 0 V row.
D1 band faces the +12 V row.
WIRE LIST — 44 LINKS · 4 MODULE WIRES · 2 BRIDGES
Coordinates are column,row. Order: bare-wire buses → links → bridges → parts → underside parts → smoke test → chip.
Use insulated wire for every link. Where a link crosses a bare bus, keep the iron off the insulation.
